body_md:
**Trade review, Fri 13 Nov: MOBIKWIK failed at 30 days, LIQUIDBEES expired flat, nothing hit a target.**

Two 30-day exits and no targets today. MOBIKWIK cost −7.3 and LIQUIDBEES 0.0, so all 84 closed trades now total +164.4% (average +2.0%), against +171.6% from 82 last night. Nifty fell 0.61% to 25,144.30. 18 trades are still running, 12 of them below their buy price, and the average of all 102 bought trades is +1.2%. No new buys today. The next 30-day exits are on Monday 16 Nov: TATAPOWER (−0.8%), CPPLUS (+1.2%) and SBICARD (+0.9%), all with T1 already booked.

**Today's results**
- ❌ **MOBIKWIK** (Retest, listed 13 Oct): failed at 30 days: Bought at ₹244.60 on 14 Oct and it never rose above the fill (best rise 0.0%); closed at ₹226.82, −7.27% (worst −15.04%), 6.9% below its ₹243.50 support. The listing chart shows a stock that jumped about 25% in a few October sessions on a huge volume spike after a year-long slide, then listed on only 0.5× volume with an ASM warning, and T2 (₹265.90) sat just under the ₹267.40 wall from last November. It traded 7.6% cheaper inside the entry window, but zone bottom only would still have lost −6.85%. It is the 11th retest failure, and it rose 25% in the month before listing.
- ➖ **LIQUIDBEES** (Candle at support, listed 13 Oct): expired flat at 30 days: A liquid-fund ETF bought at ₹999.99 and sold at ₹1,000.00, 0.00%. It cannot move 3% in a month, so it counts as a 'failure' that lost nothing. It was listed before the scan's ETF filter caught these; no liquid ETF has been listed since.

No wins closed today. Plus 57 earlier, among them PFC and TMPV (11 Nov) and DIVISLAB, KOTAKBANK and KROSS (9 Nov). These 67 wins (55 at T2, 12 partial) made +345.9%; with the 17 failures (−181.5% in total, worst MANINDS −24.56%, MOTISONS −22.63% and SMLMAH −18.63%; four of them are liquid ETFs that closed between 0.00% and +0.46%) all 84 closed trades total +164.4%. 7 of the 12 partial 'wins' lost money. T1 booked, rest still open (9): GRANULES and SBICARD (12 Nov), LUPIN (9 Nov), CPPLUS (6 Nov), TATAPOWER (5 Nov), ASTRAL (4 Nov), ONGC (2 Nov), PNGSREVA and ESCORTS (28 Oct). 5 of these 9 are below their buy price (ASTRAL −8.7%, ESCORTS −8.6%, PNGSREVA −3.9%, TATAPOWER −0.8%, ONGC −0.04%).

**Missed and better entries**
- **Missed winners still 19 of 31:** None new tonight. 23 of the 31 never bought came within 2% of the zone.
- **Zone up to 2% higher: more fills, a little more money:** Fills 93% vs 80% as listed: 13.9 points (the bar is 15). Its 101 closed trades made +194.1%, against +164.4% from 84 as listed, with 21 losing trades against 20.
- **Next day's open: shallower dips and the most money:** Worst dip −6.6% vs −7.7% as listed, 1.2 points shallower (the bar is 2). Its 99 closed trades made +223.7% with 16 losing trades; average closed trade +2.6% against +2.0%.
- **Near misses: still no failures, money from Monday:** Room-filter near misses: 87 of 123 reached T1 (71%) and 64 reached T2 (52%), against 75% and 54% for the real picks. The first of them was bought on 15 Oct, so their first 30-day exits fall on Monday 16 Nov, not today. Retest near misses: 4 of 10 at T1, 2 at T2, best rise 3.5% on average.

**Lessons**
- **Retests fill almost always, but they lose money (now off the list):** Their 31 trades average −2.8% (closed and open), and their 23 closed trades net −72.2% with 11 of the 17 failures (MOBIKWIK today). Off the list since 4 Nov. The 10 retest near misses logged since then: 4 at T1, 2 at T2. (holding)
- **Stocks that ran up before listing fail most:** Every real failure so far came from a stock that rose 5% or more in the month before listing: 13 of 13, with MOBIKWIK (+25%) today; the other 4 failures are flat liquid ETFs. Those 38 trades average −3.1% and their 31 closed trades net −109.9%; the other 64 made +274.3% from 53 closed trades, 42 at T2. Fourth review in a row, but it uses my own 5% split, not a group the tracker reports, so it cannot become a change yet. (holding)
- **Candle-at-support picks are the best group:** 37 of 41 bought reached T1 (90%) and 30 reached T2 (73%); their 33 closed trades made +173.9% with 3 failures (CENTUM, WABAG and today's flat LIQUIDBEES), and they have the shallowest dip of any style (−4.3%). (holding)
- **(missed) Support picks that never dip into the zone are often winners:** 19 of 31 never bought would have reached T1 at the next open; 23 of the 31 came within 2% of the zone. Those buys sit close to T1, so the wins are small, about +3.9% each. (holding)
- **(missed) The room-under-6% filter leaves winners out:** Its near misses trail the real picks on T1 (71% vs 75%) and T2 (52% vs 54%). Their first 30-day exits come on Monday 16 Nov; if their money also trails, this lesson will be dropped. (weakening)

Still true but out of the top 5: picks already in the buy zone at listing always fill (46 of 46). Very high trigger volume (over 2.5×) fills less often (8 of 15, 53%) and those dip −9.4%. F&O stocks reach T2 more than twice as often as cash stocks (76% vs 34%) and dip far less (−3.5% vs −11.4%).

**Proposed change:** No change tonight. Buying at the next day's open is still the best rule on money (+223.7% vs +164.4%), but its dip gain is 1.2 points against a bar of 2; zone up to 2% above gets 13.9 points more fills against a bar of 15. The strongest evidence is the run-up lesson (13 of 13 real failures), but the 5% line is my own and the tracker has no fixed group for the month-before return, so a filter value would be invented from these numbers. Adding such a group to the tracker would let it qualify; that is a scan change, so I am noting it rather than making it.

**🐞 Bug check:** nothing new. 102 bought = 55 at T2 + 12 partial + 17 failed + 18 running; T1 hit 76 ≥ T2 hit 55; no dates out of order; no duplicates; every closed return matches its fill and exit; no price revisions against last night's log and no closed row changed. LIQUIDBEES is the fourth liquid ETF on the list, all listed between 29 Sep and 13 Oct, before the scan's ETF filter; none since.
